prompts: On a private video call, hold my gaze for ten seconds, then tell me what you noticed.
Give me your best slow smile on camera, then say one thing you like about this moment.
On the call, wave as if you are meeting me for the first time and introduce yourself again.
Stay seated and do a small shoulder dance to a tune you hum yourself.
Show me the face you make when you are trying not to flirt, then drop it.
On camera, copy my smile and add one detail that makes it yours.
Blow a kiss toward the screen, then send me one playful line about it.
Use your hands to show how you would cheer when I walk into a room.
On the call, say my name in your warmest voice and hold eye contact.
Give me a ten-second look that says you are happy I answered the call.
On camera, show three expressions: curious, shy, and sure of yourself.
Tell me one sweet thing while keeping a straight face for as long as you can.
Use your hands to make a little heart on camera, then tell me what it means to you.
On the call, act out how you would greet me at a station or airport, safely from your seat.
Say one flirty sentence in the most serious voice you can manage.
On camera, look away for a moment, then meet my eyes with a smile.
Show your partner the smile you save for someone you trust.
On a video call, ask me on a tiny pretend date that lasts one minute.
Make a playful face for me, then tell me what kind of date would match it.
On camera, give me a slow nod as if you just heard a very good compliment.
Say hello as if we have been apart for a month, then say what you missed most.
On the call, show a gentle hand gesture that means 'come closer' without using words.
Keep a soft smile while I count down from five, then tell me what you were thinking.
On camera, give me your best 'I know something you don't' look and explain it.
On a private call, slowly trace a finger across your own palm while you look at me.
Brush your hair back on camera, then tell me what kind of touch feels comforting to you.
Rest a hand over your heart and tell me one way I make you feel close.
On the call, let your eyes follow my face on screen, then name one detail you like.
Draw a slow line from your wrist to your elbow with one finger, if that feels good.
Speak one affectionate sentence softly, then repeat it in your normal voice.
On camera, touch your own cheek gently and tell me what kind of affection you enjoy.
Give me a slow, warm look, then ask what kind of date would feel relaxing to me.
Move one hand through your hair and tell me which small gesture you find charming.
On the call, close your eyes for a breath, open them, and tell me what you want more of today.
Trace a small shape on your own hand while you tell me a sweet memory of us.
Hold your own hand on camera and say one thing you wish I could hear in person.
On video, lean toward the screen only as far as feels comfortable and whisper hello.
Tell me what kind of hug you miss, using words instead of pretending we are together.
Touch your shoulder gently and describe a kind of affection that feels safe to you.
On the call, give me a slow wink, then tell me what made you choose it.
Rest your chin in your hand and let me ask you one playful question.
Send a small kiss toward the screen, then ask me how I would answer it.
On camera, look at me for a quiet moment and say one thing you find attractive in my manner.
Use a gentle voice to describe how you would welcome me on a video call after a hard day.
On the call, hold your hand near your face and tell me what makes you feel cared for.
Slowly turn your face toward the camera, then say what kind of compliment feels sincere.
Tell me one kind of non-sexual touch you enjoy and one you prefer to avoid.
On camera, make a soft heart with your hands and tell me when you first felt close to me.
Send a voice note saying what you would whisper to me before a long-awaited date.
Describe the way you would make a first date feel calm for someone who feels shy.
Use a voice note to tell me what makes you feel attractive when we are apart.
Say one romantic thought you have had about our next visit, in your own words.
Record a playful invitation to a date that would fit our two cities.
Tell me what kind of attention helps you feel wanted without feeling rushed.
Send a voice note about a small detail of mine you wish you could notice up close.
Describe a sweet scene for us that needs only a call and an hour of free time.
Tell me which of my everyday habits you would miss seeing in person.
Record one sentence that makes me feel admired, then say what you mean by it.
Use your voice to tell me how you would make an ordinary evening feel romantic.
Tell me one thing you would like me to ask before I flirt more boldly.
Send a voice note asking me on a date in the style of a calm, confident host.
Describe a long-distance date you would plan for a day when we both feel tired.
Tell me a romantic what-if about the first week we could live in the same city.
Record a short message about what helps you relax when a conversation feels tender.
Say one playful line that would make you blush if I sent it to you.
Tell me what kind of voice message you would replay on a lonely evening.
Describe a place from your past you would like to show me on a call and why.
Use a voice note to share what you first hoped I might be like.
Tell me how your family shaped the kind of affection you give now.
Record a gentle compliment about the way I think, not the way I look.
Say what you would like us to talk about on a slow, private date call.
Send one voice note describing a future memory you hope we make together.
Text me the opening line you would use if we met as strangers at a quiet cafe.
Write a short scene where we plan a surprise date in our separate cities at the same time.
Send a message inviting me to a pretend first date, with one detail that feels like us.
Describe a romantic what-if: we have one free evening together and no plans yet.
Text me a two-line scene where we are both nervous before our first video date.
Write what you would say if you wanted to ask for a slow dance on a call.

Text a short role-play opening where you are the one who starts the conversation.

Write a note from a future version of you about what made our love feel steady.
Send a playful message as if we have just matched and want to learn one true thing.

Describe how you would plan a first visit if both of us needed plenty of rest.

Send me a pretend invitation to a date where we tell each other one brave truth.
Text a scene where you notice I am shy and make the moment easier for me.
Write a what-if about us getting one whole day together, with room for quiet time.
Send a flirty message that invites me to tell you what I want, without guessing for me.
Describe a romantic reunion scene using only words, and keep it non-explicit.
Text the question you would ask before planning a date that feels more intimate.

Keep your eyes on mine while you describe a romantic moment you want us to share someday.

Send a slow smile, then tell me one thing you want me to know before we get more intimate.
On camera, say what you would like me to do to help you feel safe during a romantic moment.
Describe a soft, private date you would plan for us, and ask what I would add.

Look at me on screen and say what makes you feel chosen when we are apart.
Ask me for one boundary before you share a flirty thought of your own.
On a private call, describe how you would slow a moment down if either of us felt unsure.
Tell me what kind of closeness you want more of, and what pace feels right to you.
On camera, give me a warm look and name one thing you hope I never rush.
Share a romantic fantasy about our next visit that stays gentle and non-explicit.
Ask me what I would like to hear from you when the moment feels tender.
On a private video call, hold my gaze and tell me one desire you feel safe sharing.
Say what you would want to hear if you felt shy while we were flirting.

Describe how you would make a long-distance date feel private and unhurried.
Tell me one kind of playful teasing you enjoy and one kind you do not want.

Tell me one way you would like me to show desire while still checking in with you.
